about: The church's events page titles the evening The Hollywood Christmas Village and says it celebrates the true meaning of the season with an immersive walkthrough.

The church's visit page lists the same address, 1708 N State Rd 7, Hollywood, FL 33021, with a main auditorium used for Sunday services.
The church lists its office phone as (954) 322-4302, with office hours of 9 AM to 4 PM Monday through Thursday.
A women's Christmas party on December 5, a separate ticketed church event, appears on the same calendar.
